LESSON: PRINT AWARENESS

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.3: Print Awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Print Awareness. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What pictures and out of school. in reading picture stories to each interest learners?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate awareness other. of print in and out of • Learners could view animated school. pictures and encouraged to answer
2. Show interest in questions. reading in and out of • Learners could view video clips school. depicting stories and be asked to

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PRINT AWARENESS
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Print Awareness helps you succeed in LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: PRINT AWARENESS
Study Print Awareness like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Demonstrate awareness other. of print in and out of • Learners could view animated school. pictures and encouraged to answer

What this means
In this part you learn to Demonstrate awareness other. of print in and out of • Learners could view animated school. pictures and encouraged to answer. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Demonstrate awareness other. of print in and out of • Learners could view animated school. pictures and encouraged to answer.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Print Awareness”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Demonstrate awareness other. of print in and out of • Learners could view animated school. pictures and encouraged to answer. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Show interest in questions. reading in and out of • Learners could view video clips school. depicting stories and be asked to

What this means
In this part you learn to Show interest in questions. reading in and out of • Learners could view video clips school. depicting stories and be asked to. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Show interest in questions. reading in and out of • Learners could view video clips school. depicting stories and be asked to.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Print Awareness to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Show interest in questions. reading in and out of • Learners could view video clips school. depicting stories and be asked to. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Print Awareness is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Print Awareness”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: Demonstrate awareness other. of print in and out of • Learners could view animated school. pictures and encouraged to answer)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Print Awareness to a partner. (skill: Show interest in questions. reading in and out of • Learners could view video clips school. depicting stories and be asked to)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Print Awareness to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Demonstrate awareness other. of print in and out of • Learners could view animated school. pictures and encouraged to answer.
3. Practise this skill: Show interest in questions. reading in and out of • Learners could view video clips school. depicting stories and be asked to.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Print Awareness from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Print Awareness: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP2 learner study Print Awareness?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What pictures and out of school. in reading picture stories to each interest learners?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Print Awareness means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Demonstrate awareness other. of print in and out of • Learners could view animated school. pictures and encouraged to answer.
5. Be able to: Show interest in questions. reading in and out of • Learners could view video clips school. depicting stories and be asked to.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
